Name: Pride Flag Frogs
Author: spotteddotted
Description:
Just a little mod to replace the in game frog with the CLASSIC rainbow frog emote! The secondary frog sprite has been replaced with a trans flag frog!

Thank you to my partner for pointing out that there wasn't a mod that did this yet! (At least not one that I can find)

<3

Let me know if you have any mod suggestions or there are any mistakes.
You can also [url=https://ko-fi.com/dotsanddashes]support[/url] me!
